text: Tabintin wonkii maa kin e wonndinagol e ɓen noddooɓe Joomi maɓɓe noddaandu dewal e noddaandu toraare ka arannde ñallal e ka sakkitorde maggal, ko a laɓɓinanɗo Mo, wata a yawtin ɓe gite maaɗen, faaleɗaa jooɗodugol e yimɓe anndiraaɓe ngalu e hooreyaagal, wata a tewto on mo Men waɗi ɓernde mun nden welsindii nde e jantagol Men sabu ko men uddi nde kon, sakko o yamire haɗugol ɓilliiɓe ɓen ka mbatu maa, o ardini jokkugol ko welata kon wonkii makko e dow doftagol Joomi makko, golle makko ɗen laatii yeebiiɗe.
